name: Team Squirtle: Hydro Artillery & Aerial Interception
archetype: Water/Flying aerial artillery, Electric speed sweeping, and Intimidate attack reduction.
gym_duel_rationale: Falkner's 5v5 aerial battle prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon: Blastoise/Fearow elevates to Cap 63 to anchor the frontline, using STAB Hydro Pump against Skarmory/Houndoom and Marowak/Dustox while drilling Granbull/Combusken with Drill Peck; Jolteon/Sandslash outspeeds and shocks Xatu/Noctowl and Ursaring/Pidgeot with Discharge; Arbok/Primeape cuts Ursaring/Pidgeot's Attack on switch-in with Intimidate and uses Close Combat against Skarmory/Houndoom; Alakazam/Weezing dismantles Granbull/Combusken and Marowak/Dustox with STAB Psychic; and Snorlax absorbs Flying moves with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 63. STAB Hydro Pump douses Skarmory/Houndoom and Marowak/Dustox. Drill Peck drills Granbull/Combusken cleanly.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate grants Ground immunity. STAB Psychic dismantles Granbull/Combusken and Marowak/Dustox.
486 BST speed sweeper. Discharge electrocutes Xatu/Noctowl and Ursaring/Pidgeot. Earthquake delivers crushing 4x damage to Skarmory/Houndoom once its balloon pops.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Ursaring/Pidgeot's Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat delivers massive damage to Skarmory/Houndoom.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Flying and Fire moves comfortably, resetting damage with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly freezes Flying threats across Union Cave, Route 32, and the National Park.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
